name: Team Fortress 2
tagline: SourceMod plugin for Team Fortress 2 dedicated servers (Windows or Linux) that connects to Takaro itself, no sidecar.
requirements: Team Fortress 2 dedicated server (Steam app 232250) on Windows or Linux
MetaMod:Source 1.12 and SourceMod 1.13 on the server

assets.label: Windows server
assets.requires: TF2 Windows dedicated server · MetaMod:Source 1.12 · SourceMod 1.13
assets.hint: Stop the server, unzip into the server's tf\ folder, set takaro_tf2_registration_token and takaro_tf2_identity_token in tf\cfg\sourcemod\takaro_tf2.cfg and start the server.

assets.label: Linux server
assets.requires: TF2 Linux dedicated server · MetaMod:Source 1.12 · SourceMod 1.13
assets.hint: Stop the server, unzip into the server's tf/ folder, set takaro_tf2_registration_token and takaro_tf2_identity_token in tf/cfg/sourcemod/takaro_tf2.cfg and start the server.
